name: SEA by the Bay: Summer Engineering Academy
description_short: A one-week residential engineering camp on Roger Williams University's waterfront campus in Bristol for high school juniors and above. Teams design, build and test coastal-themed prototypes, learning 3D modeling and electronics with RWU engineering professors, with afternoon activities such as a boat tour and coastal field trips and a final team showcase. Cost includes tuition and room and board.

warnings: The page gives the dates as 'July 11-16' with no year. Today is 2026-10-13, so July 2026 has already passed. 'Registration Coming Soon' and the fact that July 11, 2027 is a Sunday and July 16, 2027 is a Friday (a usual residential week) suggest these are 2027 dates. That is an inference, though, and the dates and the $1995 price could be left over from 2026. Check with RWU.
The phone number and address are the university's general contact details from the page footer, not a camp-specific contact.
